Initialize a new plugin development project

## Synopsis

```text
Initialize a new plugin development project with boilerplate code and manifest.

This command creates a new directory structure for plugin development including:
- Go module initialization
- Plugin manifest (manifest.yaml)
- Boilerplate main.go and plugin implementation
- Makefile with build scripts
- .golangci-lint.yml (golangci-lint v2; make lint passes --config)
- README.md with development instructions
- Example tests
```

```text
finfocus plugin init <plugin-name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Initialize an AWS plugin
  finfocus plugin init aws-plugin --author "Your Name" --providers aws

  # Initialize a multi-provider plugin
  finfocus plugin init cloud-plugin --author "Your Name" --providers aws,azure,gcp

  # Initialize in a specific directory
  finfocus plugin init my-plugin --author "Your Name" --providers aws --output-dir /path/to/plugins
```

## Options

```text
      --author string                     Plugin author name (required)
      --docker-only[=true|false]          Generate only Docker files (for adding to an existing project)
      --fixture-version string            Version of fixtures to fetch (tag or 'latest') (default "latest")
      --force[=true|false]                Overwrite existing files if directory exists
  -h, --help[=true|false]                 help for init
      --minimal[=true|false]              Generate minimal scaffold only (overrides --with-* flags)
      --no-docker[=true|false]            Skip Docker file generation (alias for --with-docker=false)
      --no-docs[=true|false]              Skip documentation generation (alias for --with-docs=false)
      --no-health[=true|false]            Skip health endpoint generation (alias for --with-health=false)
      --no-skill[=true|false]             Do not install the FinFocus plugin agent skills (npx skills add)
      --offline[=true|false]              Use local fixtures without network access
      --output-dir string                 Output directory for plugin project (default ".")
      --providers strings                 Supported cloud providers (e.g., aws,azure,gcp)
      --record-fixtures[=true|false]      Generate recorded request fixtures during initialization
      --strict[=true|false]               Fail initialization if recording workflow encounters errors
      --with-claude-review[=true|false]   Generate a Claude Code review workflow
      --with-docker[=true|false]          Generate Docker support files (default true)
      --with-docs[=true|false]            Generate documentation templates (default true)
      --with-health[=true|false]          Include health endpoint code (default true)
```
